eps.o: The Easter Bunny is sick, so she hires The Looney Builders to take over the festivities and ensure Looneyburg has a great Easter.
The Looney Builders are hired by Ma and Pa Bear to build a bedroom for their son, Junior, whose excitement causes setbacks.
When The Looney Builders help Wile E. Coyote build a telescope to view the Looney Moon, Tweety must face his fear of the dark.
Gossamer invites The Looney Builders on a camping trip. They plan to build a simple campsite until Daffy insists they go "glamping" instead.
The Looney Builders build Marvin the Martian and his Martian crew a space station. Marvin soon becomes overwhelmed by his Martian crew's antics and lack of personal space.
The Looney Builders discover Zippy, an acrobatic flea, living on Sylvester's back. They build Zippy a flea circus to try and convince him to relocate.
The Looney Builders are hired to build an outdoor movie theater in the park. Lola is sick, but she doesn't want to admit it.
When it starts to rain outside, Porky hopes to show The Looney Builders that they can still have fun inside by building a fort.
The Looney Builders build a castle for Elmer the Giant. They admire his toys and use them without his permission.
Fosse Ferret hires The Looney Builders to build a stage for the kids’ dance recital. Eggbert has stage fright.
The Looney Builders are hired by Mayor Leghorn to build the venue for the Looney Games. They soon become overwhelmed by the job and must ask for help.
Pete Puma hires The Looney Builders to build a roller disco for Looneyburg. Lola is new to roller skating but doesn’t want to practice.
The Looney Builders are hired by Petunia’s Grandpa Oink to upgrade his farm.
Marvin the Martian hires The Looney Builders to build an outer space ball court on Mars. Bugs is a big fan of the sport.
The Looney Builders build their headquarters a car wash. Daffy doesn’t want to wash Dumpy and goes to extreme lengths to keep him dirty.
Sunny Seagull hires The Looney Builders to build a carnival on Looneyburg's pier.
The Looney Builders take turns distracting Petunia as they build her a big surprise birthday cake in the backyard.
The Looney Builders build a float to lead the Flower Parade, but Porky won't settle for anything less than Porky Perfect.
The Looney Builders are hired to build a rollercoaster for Looneyburg.
Sam Sheepdog hires The Looney Builders to build him a salon. Sam offers his custom cut only to learn that different folks want different styles.
Pro snowboarder Pepper Polar Bear hires The Looney Builders to build a ski resort. Pepper soon learns that others have different skill levels.
Wile E. Coyote hires The Looney Builders to build him a house in the desert so he can be alone. The Road Runner tries to pay him a visit.
The Looney Builders are hired by the town’s volunteer firefighters to build a fire truck.
Zaida Gator hires The Looney Builders to build her a boat so she can share her beignets in the swamp.
Pauleen Penguin hires The Looney Builders to build an ice bowling alley in Looneyburg.
While on vacation, The Looney Builders befriend Coco the Crab and offer to build her a mini-resort.
The Looney Builders are hired by Mac Gopher to build a hot air balloon for him and Tosh to ride in for a festival.
The Looney Builders are hired by Yosemite Sam to build a dude ranch. Sam hurries the crew along, negatively impacting their work.
The Looney Builders build a baseball field, but both Bugs and Lola want to be the pitcher for the big game later.
Witch Hazel hires The Looney Builders to make her house look spooky for Halloween.
Miss Prissy hires The Looney Builders to build a grocery store for Looneyburg.
The Looney Builders play superheroes and decide to upgrade their vehicles and headquarters. However one of Wile E. Coyote's inventions goes rogue.
Yoyo Dodo hires The Looney Builders to build a funhouse for Looneyburg. The crew thinks he's goofing around as they work.
The Looney Builders are hired to build a festive course for the Fall foot race. Wile E. Coyote is determined to beat the Road Runner.
Curt Cuckoo hires The Looney Builders to build a giant cuckoo clock in Germany to signal the start of Martinstag.
The Looney Builders are hired to build a surfside hangout in Australia for a surfing competition.
The Looney Builders are hired by Giovanna Badgerini to update her family’s pizzeria. However, Giovanna’s Mamma prefers the old way of doing things.
Carina Capybara hires The Looney Builders to build her Samba School a float for Brazil's Carnaval parade.
The Looney Builders are hired by Parth Peacock to build a puppet stage and puppets in India.
After a hot cocoa disaster, Santa Claus hires The Looney Builders to build him a new toyshop in time to save Christmas.
